comments.body: @jakevdp would you be able to help review the PR on this dtype issue in ode.py?

issue.body:
This is happening on the `main` branch and in 0.2.25, not in some older versions. 
I think it was introduced in https://github.com/google/jax/commit/de777c8d37fed5504e5b161a40f4fbdc3bb31026

Code to reproduce the issue: Modified from `tests/ode_test.py` by adding ` * jnp.exp(-t)` in line 11.
```python
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import jax.test_util as jtu
from jax.experimental.ode import odeint


def test_complex_odeint():
    print(jax.__version__)

    def dy_dt(y, t, alpha):
        return alpha * y * jnp.exp(-t)

    def f(y0, ts, alpha):
        return odeint(dy_dt, y0, ts, alpha).real

    alpha = 3 + 4j
    y0 = 1 + 2j
    ts = jnp.linspace(0., 1., 11)
    tol = 1e-1

    jtu.check_grads(f, (y0, ts, alpha), modes=["rev"], order=2, atol=tol, rtol=tol)


test_complex_odeint()
```
The error that's thrown is `TypeError: mul requires arguments to have the same dtypes, got float32, complex64.`, full trace below.

It looks like in https://github.com/google/jax/blob/main/jax/experimental/ode.py#L95, the dtype of `alpha` is `complex64`, which leads to a complex time `ti` in `https://github.com/google/jax/blob/main/jax/experimental/ode.py#L112`.
So `func_` in https://github.com/google/jax/blob/main/jax/experimental/ode.py#L184 gets called sometimes with a time of dtype `float32`, and sometime `complex64`, which seems to cause this problem.

The fix should be to change the dtype of `alpha` in https://github.com/google/jax/blob/main/jax/experimental/ode.py#L95 from `f0.dtype` to `t0.dtype`.

I'm happy to put together a PR!
